opening.argument: The presentation makes a direct offer of recurring Bitcoin income tied to payment for equipment and membership in BitClub Network. It proposes that viewers mine Bitcoin through the network, claiming that the club makes Bitcoin daily and distributes it among members, while promising that payment toward equipment will bring “more and more bitcoin each day.” It further combines mining with MLM network-building, stating that viewers can build their own network and receive income. The appeal is not merely informational: viewers are invited to join immediately and directed to a registration link and business contact. Alongside the claim that Bitcoin will always grow in price, these paid-entry, recurring-return promises present the network as a way to earn through recruitment and mining.

citations.quote: Our club makes Bitcoin every day, for more than two years, and distributes it evenly among club members
you will always be able to get more and more bitcoin each day by paying a part of the funds in order to purchase equipment
BitClub Network is the only one who is able to combine the Bitcoin mining and MLM business
I invite you to become a member of the Bitcoin Club Network today.
Under this video you can find a link to the registration and contacts of this person who will help you disassemble the business and answer all your questions.
